name: How do I choose the right general contractor for an interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for an interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for an active owner-operator or lead who maintains direct, hands-on presence on the jobsite rather than an off-site salesperson who hands your project to strangers. Verify BBB accreditation, verify licensing and trade insurance, and ask who your day-to-day point of contact will be. Inquire how they handle specialty trades like electrical and plumbing versus their in-house tasks. A trustworthy contractor explains their trade coordination clearly, provides realistic start dates, and offers straightforward communication throughout the estimate and construction phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an accredited, insured contractor with hands-on jobsite management, clear communication, verified references, and transparent trade coordination processes.
